build_gaussian_kernel: build a torch JIT scripted gaussian kernel function for a tensor with given mean and std
create_polynomial_envelope: create a PolynomialEnvelope module with a configurable exponent for smooth cutoff of scaled distances
build_gaussian_smearing: build a GaussianSmearing module to embed distances into a Gaussian basis with configurable range and count
create_radial_mlp: create a RadialMLP module with linear layers, layer normalization, and SiLU activations from a channel list
test_radial_mlp_forward: test the RadialMLP forward pass by passing a tensor through the sequential network
